label: Guard-free axial lift
title: A guard-free dimensional tower: compatibility and axis order
summary: A binary axial constructor preserves literal replication for exactly 66 ECA sources at every dimensional interface. Twenty-four rules are independent of axis order; 14 satisfy both requirements.
takeaway: Guard rows are not necessary for exact dimensional compatibility, but replication and usually axis order remain supplied choices. The next test asks whether transverse differences have autonomous dynamics.
